notes.title: Medieval Shopkeeper Simulator Now Free On Steam (Read more for details)
notes.notes:
Hello,

Hello, Over a year ago my project files for Medieval Shopkeeper Simulator got corrupted and until now it was impossible for me to recreate/fix them. This is my first game and i really wanted it to be great. In this situation, i could either remove this game or make it completely free and decide to make it free for everyone, but all the people who already own it will receive a copy of my other game Little Dungeon Stories, soon it should appear in their Steam library.

I will continue working on my current projects and try to deliver you more cool games in near future.

Little Dungeon Stories is almost finished:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1069050/Little_Dungeon_Stories/

You can grab my other game on Steam for free Himno:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/931690/Himno/

As well im currently working on a sequel Himno: The Silent Melody
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1079230/Himno__The_Silent_Melody/

Really sorry again.
David

notes.title: NEW BIG UPDATE 17! Improved Basic Gameplay Base, Rain System and More!
notes.notes:

Hello everyone! It's been a while since I updated the game, it's time to do it and in a big way! Lots of improvements in basic gameplay and other features like a Rain System.

[h1]Let's see what this build contains:[/h1]
[list]
[h1]NEW CONTENT[/h1]
[*] Jump is deleted.
[*] You can now set a number of items to craft + New progress bar.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33066823/704f5c9ab2dac3520676ba7c9f6c4a5a3f451575.png[/img]

[*] House orders/contracts system totally reworked.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33066823/431dc36710c00132463ec1ac1924b64328c798b7.png[/img]

[*] New rain system + Interactions with stalls, crops and people + Clouds!

notes.title: New Little Dev Log Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! I have more news of the coming MSS' update, let's take a look.

Basically I'm working on the interface of the "Merchant Book". The [b]WHOLE Book's UI[/b] will be replaced by a panel as the Intentory or any other.

[i]It will change from this:[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32352693/6428154400f0be6daf760fb6481dbbd8430ec4d6.png[/img]

[i]To this:[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32352693/b47db6ce2ad4a68282325c1011aa7a03dd403412.png[/img]
[list]
[*] So the whole interface looks much clearer. Also undiscovered objects will be shaded and those discovered with color. The page tabs are missing, they will be placed on the left of the panel instead on top. It is not finished, some details are missing but that is how it will be.

[*] Also orders to the merchant, will be made in a couple of minutes and not in days. I think the lost game bug was triggered by this feature, so removing this, surely this bug will be finally fixed.

[*] The tutorial will be deleted as well, although I already said this in another announcement.

[*] I'm also going to make opening your first store less chaotic at the beginning by making your first stall already acquired. You will no longer have to go to the stalls board to buy the stores, simply go to one and buy it.
[/list]

Thank you all for the support and have a happy week ːsteamhappyː
Ask me any questions [url=https://twitter.com/BreakfastStudi1]here[/url] in Twitter.

- David

notes.title: DEV LOG UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hey, I have not been very active around here due to my recent release of Himno. The plans I have for MSS are the following:

I am focused on improving the base experience of the game right now, rather than on getting new content, since there is a lot of things to do but bugs may hinder the experience.

Also I've decided that I'm going to delete the tutorial. Instead, I'm going to do a series of short video tutorials showing the basics of the game for new players. There are certain people who have told me that it is much more enjoyable to discover how the game works by yourself rather than having a crappy tutorial.

Have a nice day and as always, thanks for supporting me ːsteamhappyː
my [url=https://twitter.com/BreakfastStudi1]twitter[/url] if you have any question c:

- David

notes.title: HELLO AGAIN! LET'S KEEP UPDATING THE GAME! + NEW UPDATE 14
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/995764848900234386/1AA863143F21A587348C12E5920DF1ED23A4DC0E/[/img]

Hi everyone. Honestly there is not much I can say about what happened during these months. I feel very embarrassed for not updating or giving a statement, I'm very sorry. But in summary, I have burned a lot with this project and I needed to take some time away from it. Now I want to continue updating it again!

But this time, so that the same thing does not happen to me again, I will make updates less often but bigger. And I will work on other projects to not get tired of this game, as I did with Himno. That said, let's see what brings this update.

During this time, I focused on finishing the interior house build system which was a headache but it's finally here. This announcement is the start of a new Alpha Release: Expanding Frontiers. With this coming updates I will be focused on new places and lands to explore along with other cool things.

Let's see what this build contains:
[list]
NEW CONTENT
[*] Instead of 4 Save slots, now there is only 1. This solves many save problems, not all. I have to continue testing but if you find any bug, 
do not hesitate to post it in "Discussions".
[*] New interior house build system, to decorate your house with furniture and more cool things!
(When you're inside your house, just press "2" and then hit the "Tab" to open the Build Menu)
[*] For now, new furniture items can be unlocked only by talking with customers. In the next update, 
the architect will be the one who gives you new blueprints. (46 items in total, more upcoming!)
[*] House Interior upgrades, buy them and increase your house size (3 in total for now).
[*] Main menu options panel is removed, now the options can only be accessed within the game.
[*] Improved tutorial.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32352693/aed3d461e50830031ce61b7829cfa1161b84e838.png[/img]

BUG FIXES
[*] Placing an item in a non-player store won't destroy the item and no longer will crash the game.
[*] Some performance improvements when you start or load a game.
[*] Minor fixes.
[/list]

You can ask any question as always, I will try to answer it as fast as I can.

Have a nice week and as always, thanks for continuing to support me! ːsteamhappyː

David.

notes.title: IMPORTANT UPDATE + SPECIAL ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32352693/916ed97b3d6acc4e7fd61b6db206f413faac0a2b.png[/img]

Hello everyone! As you have seen during these days, I have not updated the game. This is due to several things: 
[list]
[*]Right now I'm programming internal systems which I can not stop halfway to upload an update every Friday, because it would give error.
[*]I had some vacations in my town since there were festivities and I haven't had real vacations since years.
[*]Also, I am working on upgrading and customizing the house interior, with cool upgrades and furniture blueprints to unlock.
[/list]
During this time, I have been thinking several things such as uploading an update every 2 weeks instead of 1. It does not give me physical time to program a complex system in a week without errors and also have some life apart from doing this project.

As you know, I am working alone on this big project and it will take me some time to complete it. That's why in my free time, I'm always doing other small projects to distract myself from this game, because being 24/7 just burns me.

I'm going to make a special announcement. Some time ago, when I was having a hard time in my life, I made a little relaxing game to forget myself and think more clearly. As I liked it so much, I decided to share it with the community for free. It's called Himno.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32352693/be001a3650d05ff73fd8d5934d3518e2be8450c0.png[/img]

It will be released in a month or so totally free.

I think I have nothing left to explain/say. If you have any questions, do not hesitate to leave a comment or start a discussion. There will be an update with new content next week.

Have a nice weekend and as always, thanks for supporting me ːsteamhappyː

David.

notes.title: Premature Evaluation: Medieval Shopkeeper Simulator
notes.notes:
Premature Evaluation is the weekly column in which we explore the wilds of early access. This week, Fraser s moonlighting as a grouchy stall owner in Medieval Shopkeeper Simulator, a first-person fantasy retail romp.

With the chaos of E3 fast approaching, I m looking for a more sedate racket. No more of this videogame malarky, I m going to sell rocks and sticks to the impoverished serfs of Medieval Shopkeeper Simulator. It will be the greatest rock and stick emporium in all the land, or at least this postcode. I used to work in retail, so I m sure I ll have a handle on it in no time.

(more…)
